label: Club DJ
note: Issue #261: the club's DJ, behind the desk with the glowing buttons and the two glowing decks (ClubProps.dj_desk). A non-combatant on the stage: plays the set loop (ClubMoves 'dj': decks, a cue in the headphones, a hand in the air, long looks round the room) with the hands on the desk, and stays damageable. 'band': killing them stops the club's music (Sound.set_club_live(false)); a new band plays the next visit. 'bpm': the beat the loop nods to.
